name: Image to Video by RunComfy
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Image to Video by RunComfy animates existing photos and product images into short clips using compatible models from the RunComfy catalog, including available Seedance, Wan and Kling image-to-video models.

What you can do:
• Turn an image into a short clip with described subject movement.
• Add a slow push-in, pan or another supported camera movement to a still scene.
• Animate a product photo while identifying the appearance details to check.
• Retrieve a finished clip or check the status of an existing generation.

Connect a RunComfy account to generate videos. Generations use your RunComfy account balance. Duration, resolution, audio and reference options depend on the selected model and its current input schema.

The starting image must be available through an accessible HTTPS link. If a chat attachment cannot be passed to the model, the plugin asks for a usable image link. Motion may change faces, product shape, labels or background details; inspect the actual clip before using it. A single image cannot establish accurate unseen sides of an object, and seamless loops or exact motion are not guaranteed.
